create_bpf_program_from_python_function: create a BPF program from a Python function using create_prog with a ProgType and context type
load_bpf_program_into_kernel: load a BPF program into the kernel using _load_prog with raw instructions and program type
get_kernel_version_encoded: get the encoded kernel version integer from the running system using _get_kern_version
close_bpf_program_fd: close a loaded BPF program file descriptor by calling Prog.close on the Prog instance
review_prog_class: review the Prog class that wraps BPF program loading and provides a close method for cleanup
